up: For the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1614038, retrieve all compounds that have been tested and for which exact activity measurements are available (i.e., standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null). For each such measurement, provide the following columns: the compound's ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary), the compound's preferred name (if any), the canonical SMILES representation of the compound's structure (from compound_structures), the activity standard type, the numeric standard value, and the units of the standard value. Do not include compounds that only have approximate or relational measurements (e.g., '>', '<'). Return all matching rows without a limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614038' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
